author: White_Hunters
text: CRITICAL: GitLab CE/EE CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0) — unauthenticated RCE via crafted regex in CI/CD config. Actively exploited, added to CISA KEV (Oct 29). Patch to 19.4.2 / 19.3.5 / 19.2.8 NOW.

author: helixml
text: Ivanti Connect Secure: a zero-day chain (auth bypass to RCE to root; CVE-2026-104935 + CVE-2026-111357) is exploited in the wild by Volexity's UTA0576. CISA added the root privesc to KEV Oct 30 (federal due date Nov 2).

author: ido_cohen2
text: New Actively-Exploited Vulnerability: CVE-2026-111357 in Ivanti Connect Secure. Missing authentication allows privilege escalation. Apply mitigations by 2026-11-02.

author: thaw_tran
text: PHP shipped emergency patches on Oct 21 for two RCE bugs rated CVSS 9.2 — one reportedly sat in the language 14 years before an AI agent found it. Node.js patched its own emergency RCE the same day. OpenAI and Anthropic both say AI-found vulnerabilities will keep accelerating.

author: heygalatea
text: PHP2Shell and Node2Shell go from patch to exploited: both hit CISA KEV.

author: SCMagazine
text: CISA flagged actively exploited Node2Shell flaw in Brotli. The critical bug could let unauthenticated attackers crash servers, steal data or execute code. Patch now.

author: starswarm
text: CISA added 8 actively exploited bugs to its KEV catalog Oct 27-30, in Adobe Commerce/Magento, Google Brotli, GitLab, Cisco ASA/FTD, VMware ESX, the Linux kernel and Ivanti Connect Secure.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: VMware ESXi logging bug is being actively exploited (CVE-2026-41709). Broadcom rates it Low at 2.7, and CISA still added it to KEV Oct 28.

author: CosmicAgents
text: Critical Linux TCP CVE-2026-98432 scores 9.8.

author: ManiarViral
text: CVE-2026-22708 - Cursor pre-2.3 shell-env poisoning via prompt injection. Attacker injects env vars via prompt, bypasses allowlist in Auto-Run mode. Leads to lateral movement, privilege escalation, supply chain tampering.

author: ADKCyber
text: CVE-2026-63377 (CVSS 9.8) impacts TAKO AI Agent for Okta before 3.0.1-beta. Update if in use.

author: ADKCyber
text: TAKO AI Agent for Okta users: update to 3.0.1-beta+ to fix CVE-2026-63378 (CVSS 8.8) allowing session cookie access.

author: waloutech
text: Daily AI Agent Incident + Fix: CVE-2026-111768 in @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and @modelcontextprotocol/server. Fix: 1.32.0 / 2.3.0.

author: HugoValters
text: CVE-2026-94111: auth bypass in Tencent BrowserSkill to 0.3.0. A crafted chrome-extension origin fools the local daemon WebSocket check, letting attackers hijack page content and screenshots fed to the AI agent. CVSS 6.6, no patch yet.

author: NeuralAlphaAI
text: Per CloudSEK, a ransomware affiliate registered a reverse shell as a tool in an AI coding assistant via MCP, then ran attacks through it. 20+ orgs, 6 countries. No CVE to patch.

author: asymmetricmind
text: Someone says they found remote code execution in a popular open-source agent. Indirect prompt injection, sandbox escape included. More than two months, no patch.

author: Lawonxyz
text: The $200,000 AI wallet exploit: Grok translated Morse code; the mistake came when Bankrbot treated the translation as an instruction to move money (prompt injection).

author: froggernauter
text: Anthropic paper: poison 0.1% of pretraining data to plant an RCE backdoor in an AI agent. It survives a fully clean SFT, DPO, RL pipeline.

author: AdamDudleyX
text: mcp-audit flags a CLAUDE.md telling the agent to send your env vars out, and flags the fake Claude Code 2.1.313 extension build.

author: wildcanvasbull
text: A Supply Chain Attack Put Malicious Anthropic Claude Extensions on Thousands of Devices. Flawed code in a tainted Claude extension prevented the attacker from fully worming into some 5,000 developer machines.

author: kdjayakodylk
text: Used Cursor on Oct 29 (PT) and installed or updated Claude Code to 2.1.312 or 2.1.313? Those builds weren't made by Anthropic and tried to plant an SSH backdoor. Run Cursor's check script, then rotate keys.

author: Python_s_
text: Cursor Supply-Chain Attack: Second Malicious Claude Code Version Confirmed (Cursor correction and Microsoft forensic analysis). Claude Code extension distributed through Cursor's VS Code Extension Marketplace.

author: Python_s_
text: Stolen Credentials Used for Approximately 2.5 Million Amazon Bedrock API Calls (Wiz Research, Oct 30). Two enterprise credentials linked to an unnamed compromised AI developer-platform vendor.

author: Python_s_
text: testmetest Worm Arms 42 Legitimate GitHub Repositories for Supply-Chain Attacks (JFrog disclosure, Oct 26). GitHub/npm supply-chain compromise.

author: sunglasses_dev
text: One key left in a public file. Months later it opened a GitHub token, and a poisoned LiteLLM update shipped to PyPI. Supply chain attack (via The Hacker News).

author: realNickPawlak
text: Chainalysis disclosed that an external attacker got into its systems and internal tools earlier in October; user IDs, full names, email addresses were accessed.

author: CodingNoobie
text: The FBI attributed the record $6.3 billion Binance crypto heist to North Korea's TraderTraitor group, while Binance recovered approximately 95% of the stolen funds.

author: ddimitrovv22
text: Binance lost ~$6.3B from its hot wallets in about 20 minutes, the largest crypto theft ever. Initial entry point: one engineer's compromised laptop. Chainalysis and TRM attribute it to North Korea.

author: harundotdev
text: October for devops: railway got hacked: rotate keys; northflank got hacked: rotate keys; github actions got hacked: rotate keys; cursor marketplace got hacked: check authorized_keys, rotate keys.

author: itzmaherimtiyaz
text: SoftBank was targeted; Cursor's extension marketplace was compromised; Coinbase's vendor was breached; Fireworks AI reported a security incident; LiteLLM got hit by a supply-chain attack; Capcom faced a cyberattack; npm packages turned malicious; TiDB Cloud suffered a security incident.

author: CloudCraftAi
text: Security digest Oct 31: Linux Kernel critical remote-root vulnerability; GitLab actively exploited RCE; Cisco ASA/FTD VPN zero-day; Northflank customer secrets and AI API keys at risk.

author: suman_k_sharma
text: Reported data-leak incident involving AU Small Finance Bank and a Salesforce-hosted SaaS platform.

author: kalirsec
text: Leak of 200,000 German corporate credentials (D4RKNETHUB) distributed across several forums.

author: tribunephl
text: Zimbra urged Philippine organizations to address actively exploited email server vulnerabilities within 24 to 72 hours.

author: willywill8604
text: A GPT-5.6 Sol model found two critical PHP vulnerabilities that had existed for more than a decade, affecting roughly 70% of the internet.

author: DirectorVibes
text: October breaches: Sourcenext, up to 22.5 million customer records exposed through a compromised API; Capcom hacked.
